title: ZSS Khordha Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Medical Officer Posts
description: Zilla Swasthya Samiti Khordha (ZSS Khordha) has declared the latest job notification for the recruitment of 02 Medical Officer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS can grab this opportunity and apply for the ZSS Khordha Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
